policy: V27 creates a new distribution handoff family bound exactly to distribution.available-capacity/v3. Historical Plan/Authorization/ExecutionTicket v1/v2 remain immutable. The v3 path cannot accept legacy capacity generations and preserves separate beneficiary principal and payer-borne external-fee budget semantics.

additions.authority_note: Exact beneficiary batch plan bound only to distribution.available-capacity/v3. Principal + fee budget must fit the fee-aware current capacity. No authorization/payment/execution/AI authority.
Human committee or multisig decision only. Binds exact Plan v3, AvailableCapacity v3, beneficiary set, principal, fee budget and total ceiling. AI authority NONE.
Short-lived final Financial OS handoff gate for the exact v3 bundle. Payment authority is MetaPay-only handoff; execution authority remains NONE.
